activities.name: Iterate Execution of Process Date Range

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat('select fulldate
from 
    eds.eds_ctl ect
inner join 
    eds.date_dim dd
    on 
    ect.',pipeline().parameters.src_sys,'_DATE=dd.previous_business_day
    and dd.business_day_flag=''Y''')
